capabilities: Archive completed tasks to an archive file or date tree
Delete completed tasks from the current file
Archive the whole section under the cursor's heading
Sort list items by completeness under the cursor
Toggle a task done and archive it in one command
extras: Before/after examples are shown only as code blocks; a rules system for custom per-task workflows is partly open-ended, with the author inviting feature requests.
motivation: The author wanted to bring some of Emacs org-mode's completed-task handling features to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to clear completed tasks out of active notes and collect them elsewhere.

relations.evidence: This plugin is an implementation of some features of org-mode for Emacs.
This way you can archive tasks created with the obsidian-tasks plugin where they belong
obsidian-outliner. This plugin is a beauty in terms of architecture and code quality
I relied on the code from these excellent plugins: - obsidian-kanban

summary: Task toolbox that moves completed tasks out of a note into an archive file, optionally organizing them in a date tree.
